title: Product Requirements Document (PRD) – ZeroFlat
vision: A local-first, offline-capable application for body asymmetry and mental-state tracking. It utilizes a unified Rust core, Flutter frontend, and P2P synchronization via GuardianDB (Iroh/Willow). The system prioritizes Postcard for all serialization to ensure maximum efficiency and architectural homogeneity.
objectives: Offline-first with P2P synchronization as the primary data path
Unified serialization strategy using Postcard across DB, P2P, and UI Bridge
Zero-knowledge multi-device identity via Iroh Ed25519 keys
Fast, local full-text search via FrankenSQLite (FTS5)
SDUI (Server-Driven UI) orchestrated by the Conduit FBP engine
Separate analysis app for RDF/SPARQL reasoning via Kolibrie

architectural_updates.serialization: Postcard (replaces FlatBuffers). Used for GuardianDB storage, Iroh/Willow wire format, and Rinf binary signals.
architectural_updates.p2p_engine: GuardianDB (utilizing Iroh-Docs/Willow for sync, Iroh-Blobs for data, and Iroh-Gossip for signals).
architectural_updates.ui_bridge: Rinf using RustSignalBinary/DartSignalBinary traits for zero-copy Postcard transfer.
architectural_updates.orchestration: Conduit FBP (Rust-based) acting as the single source of truth for data flow and UI state.

high_level_requirements: Use Conduit for all logic orchestration between Flutter and Rust
Implement GuardianDB as the local-first storage and P2P replication layer
Utilize Postcard for all data structures to ensure compatibility with GuardianDB internals
Provide QR-based key export (encrypted Ed25519) for multi-device linking
Maintain a separate RDF analysis path where Postcard blobs are mapped to Kolibrie triples

functional_requirements.F1: Incremental form editing: Tap events processed as CRDT ops in Rust, buffered before GuardianDB commit.
functional_requirements.F2: Completed forms stored as Postcard blobs in GuardianDB.
functional_requirements.F3: Immutable event log (GuardianDB internal) preserved for historical analysis.
functional_requirements.F4: Local FTS5 search: Rust-side indexer derives searchable text from Postcard blobs into FrankenSQLite.
functional_requirements.F5: Background P2P sync via Iroh Magicsock (handling NAT traversal/roaming).
functional_requirements.F6: SDUI: UI layouts defined in Rust (Postcard), rendered in Flutter via Rinf binary signals.
functional_requirements.F7: Update Mechanism: Signed delta updates delivered via Iroh Blobs and handled by Conduit.

non_functional_requirements.performance: Sub-100ms UI response; zero-copy binary transfer across the Rinf bridge.
non_functional_requirements.homogeneity: Single serialization format (Postcard) across the entire stack to reduce architectural debt.
non_functional_requirements.security: E2EE via Iroh/Willow; at-rest encryption (XChaCha20-Poly1305) using OS keyring.
non_functional_requirements.scalability: Efficiently handles 1k-3k forms per client with low memory overhead.

data_flow: Flutter (User Input) -> Rinf (Binary Signal) -> Conduit (Logic/FBP) -> GuardianDB (Postcard Blob + CRDT Sync) -> Iroh/Willow (P2P Wire) -> Analysis App (Postcard -> RDF Mapper -> Kolibrie).
